body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-07-29 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "from Q3, Q4 onwards, you will definitely see a significant uptick happening in the non-T&D, whether it is civil, whether it is cables" Metric: Non-T&D revenue. Target: growth from Q2FY26, significant by Q3-Q4. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: Non-T&D revenue FY25 ~41% of 21,847 = ~8,960 cr -> FY26 32% of 23,506 = ~7,520 cr, ~-16% (derived from T&D shares). Only cables grew. Explanation given: labour, work fronts, water, railway run-down (Q4FY26 opening)

body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-07-29 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "So even in the unlikely, say, that PGCIL takes something against us or something, I don't think it's going to impact our T&D growth in any manner" Metric: T&D growth / India T&D order intake. Target: no impact. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: partly. Evidence: T&D revenue grew +24% in FY26 (no revenue impact). But KEC received no PGCIL orders for ~15 months ('orders & L1 of over INR3,000 crores from PGCIL after a break of 15 months', Nov-26) and India T&D intake fell to ~INR 6,400 cr (derived) from ~7,200. The analyst's question (Jul-25) referred to 'this bribery case with Power Grid officials, which is under inquiry'; management gave no outcome. Governance item - single-source (transcript only). Explanation given: TBCB shift to private developers (volunteered); the PGCIL gap itself was never explained
